facts.fact: StackAdapt announced on June 10, 2025 that it had been named on the 2025 Best Workplaces in Advertising and Marketing list.
facts.quote: our organization has been named on the 2025 Best Workplaces in Advertising and Marketing.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's own description, its AI-powered Marketing Platform performs 465 billion automated optimizations per second.
facts.quote: With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing

facts.fact: To be eligible for the Great Place to Work Best Workplaces in Advertising and Marketing list, an organization must be Great Place to Work-Certified and have exceptionally high scores from employees on the Trust Index survey.
facts.quote: To be eligible for this list, organizations must be Great Place to Work- Certified™ and have exceptionally high scores from employees on the Trust Index survey.

facts.fact: The list is based on employee feedback from hundreds of organizations surveyed by Great Place to Work, per the press release.
facts.quote: The list is based on direct feedback from employees of the hundreds of organizations that were surveyed by Great Place to Work®.

facts.fact: Great Place to Work states that in Canada it represents the voices of 500,000 employees across industry (a third-party organization's claim).
facts.quote: In Canada, Great Place to Work® produces both industry and demographic specific Best Workplace™ lists, and represents the voices of 500,000 employees across industry.
